summary: Reviewed all three modified files: store-config.ts (StoreListItem extension), store-router.ts (skipDirCreate option), and store-router.test.ts (3 new tests). Implementation is clean across all dimensions. No blocking issues found.

StoreListItem interface extension: five fields (is_default, is_git, ahead?, behind?, sync?) are correctly typed and co-located with the existing schema. Boolean flags use the correct is_ prefix; optional numeric fields match Git terminology; sync reuses the already-validated StoreSyncMeta type.

skipDirCreate option: the optional-chaining guard !options?.skipDirCreate is idiomatic TypeScript and handles all four cases (omitted, undefined, false, true) correctly. Guard wraps the entire loop rather than individual mkdirSync calls — correct and efficient. Inline comment explains the motivation (hot-reload / unmounted drives) rather than restating the code.

Tests: three tests cover the full behavioral matrix for skipDirCreate. Tests verify real filesystem state (existsSync) rather than mocking mkdirSync, which tests observable behavior rather than implementation details. No cross-contamination between test cases.
Two documentation-forward items raised (both non-blocking). No code changes applied.

comments.note: [documentation-forward] StoreListItem interface has no field-level JSDoc for the five new fields. Document what is_git: false implies for ahead/behind (should both be undefined), when sync is populated vs undefined, and whether is_default can be false for all items simultaneously (e.g. during a config reload). These semantics are not inferrable from the type alone.

[documentation-forward] StoreRouter class-level JSDoc 'Directory auto-creation' section does not mention the skipDirCreate constructor option, and the constructor has no @param options entry. Add a @param jsdoc tag and update the section to note that skipDirCreate suppresses the mkdirSync loop.

The options bag is currently a single-field inline type { skipDirCreate?: boolean }. If a second option is added later (e.g. validatePaths), it would benefit from extraction to a named StoreRouterOptions interface. Not blocking at current size — flag for the next change to the constructor signature.

summary: Added field-level JSDoc to the five new StoreListItem fields in store-config.ts: documents the is_default/false-for-all edge case (legacy/single-store mode), the is_git → ahead/behind invariant (both undefined when is_git is false or no remote), and the informational-only nature of sync.

Updated StoreRouter class-level 'Directory auto-creation' section to mention the skipDirCreate option and added a @param options.skipDirCreate JSDoc tag to the constructor explaining the default (false = directories created) and the intended use case (hot-reload / unmounted drives).
TypeScript type-check passes cleanly with zero errors after both changes.

comments.note: Both documentation-forward items from the code review are addressed. The is_git/ahead/behind invariant and is_default edge cases are now encoded directly in the interface so IDEs surface them on hover — no separate prose doc required.
